title: No Need For Atomic Bombs
body:
The countryside everywhere is safer than cities. The countryside. Parliamentary, and military zones are not
safe. Believers are in safety, and worshippers are much more in safety, and servants of the Divine Presence
are in full safety. (Sheikh then names a place in Malaysia) J...? is much safer than Kuala Lumpur.
Questioner: Should I take my mother out?
You are living in J... ?
Questioner: Not yet, I will be.
Ask 'Abd ar-Rahman, 'Abd ar-Rahman is living in the countryside. It is a good place for a time. For a short
time, but through that short time many people are going to be taken away as we said. Those who are only
depending on technology, are never going to live, they are finishing. During that first night without
technology, billions of people will be dead by morning - without atomic bombs, nuclear bombs. No need for
them. Because if nuclear bombs are used they will poison the earth and I don't think that permission should
be given to allow that. But in another way people may die, in billions, because technology will stop, or they
are going to go crazy, to go mad, and in a short time they will also pass away, so that those who never ask for

spiritual or Heavenly Support are not going to live. Finishing. Yes. May Allah forgive and grant you, and
forgive me, and give blessings. Fatiha.
Lefke - 01.05.1999
